story.iWant: a dashboard showing governance state, proposals, votes, and trust
story.soThat: democracy is transparent and I can monitor the system's political health

Create active proposals view with vote counts
Create constitutional view with red lines highlighted

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Dashboard Route: /governance serves interactive dashboard
System Health: Show governance health (users, proposals, constitution status)
Real-time Updates: WebSocket or polling for live updates
Mobile Responsive: Dashboard works on mobile devices
Active Proposals: List of open proposals with vote counts
Proposal Details: Click to see full proposal, votes, and timeline
Vote History: My votes across all proposals
Quick Vote: Cast vote directly from dashboard
Trust Scores: My trust scores per domain
Domain Leaderboard: Top experts per domain
Trust Trend: Graph of trust changes over time
Expertise Claims: Manage my claimed expertise
Constitution Display: View current constitution
Red Lines: Highlighted red lines with explanations
Amendment History: Timeline of constitutional changes
Violation Log: Proposals blocked by constitution
Governance Metrics: Participation rate, quorum health
Vote Analytics: Voting patterns, consensus trends
Escalation History: All escalations and resolutions
Export: Download governance data as CSV/JSON
